relations.text: Workivaのプラットフォームは主にAmazon Web Servicesの上に構築されている
relations.text_en: Workiva's platform is built primarily on Amazon Web Services

source.label: Workiva 10-K
source.quote: Our platform, built primarily on Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), is composed of both proprietary and open-source technologies.

relations.text: Workivaは、SAP Cloud Platform Integrationサービスを使った第一者連携を提供するSAPの技術パートナーである
relations.text_en: Workiva is an SAP technology partner and delivers a first-party integration using the SAP Cloud Platform Integration service

source.label: Workiva partner page
source.quote: As an SAP technology partner, Workiva delivers a first-party integration with Workiva solutions using the SAP ® Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) service.

relations.text: WorkivaはSAPとOEM契約を結んだと発表した
relations.text_en: Workiva announced it signed an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) agreement with SAP

source.label: Workiva の発表
source.quote: Workiva (NYSE:WK), a leader in cloud-based data collaboration, reporting and compliance solutions, today announced it has signed an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) agreement with SAP (NYSE:SAP).
